name: month
description: Reference month of the observation, from 1 to 12

name: country_id
description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the country the series refers to
observations: NULL for global or aggregate series (global EPU, global GPR). US categorical and US component series carry USA

name: index_family
description: Index family: epu (Economic Policy Uncertainty) or gpr (Geopolitical Risk)

name: index_name
description: Coded identifier of the specific index series; labels are in the dicionario table
observations: Base periods and newspaper panels differ across series and across countries, so cross-series and cross-country comparisons of levels are not meaningful

name: value
description: Value of the index for the given series and period
observations: Index points (base = 100 in the series' reference window) for EPU and global GPR; share of geopolitically-focused articles in percent for country-level GPR (country_id not null)
